g.text: null B: 10-residue repeat kept, word changed (20 draws)
TOOLS: query Q25460 and its 40 null draws against Swiss-Prot 2026_03
plus 3 TrEMBL entries; kmerseek 0.4, 171 searched settings; colour =
method, as in the figure above
HYPOTHESIS: a method that reads the order of residues reaches the
mussel proteins from the real query and not from shuffled copies
CONCLUSION: the composition scans reach them from shuffled copies as
often as from the real query (55% of lists); kmerseek from shuffled
copies in 0.2% of lists, against 44% from the real query; MMseqs2,
whose first wrong hit scores only 31 bits, in 30%
